mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide may cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia which can potentiate albendazole's hepatotoxicity risk and affect drug metabolism; albendazole is hepatically metabolized and may compete for metabolic pathways.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium) and liver function tests periodically; ensure adequate hydration and consider potassium supplementation if needed during concurrent use.
